mission_prompt: Enterprise RFP Proposal & Pricing Factory: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: If an RFP file is provided, read its text; otherwise autonomously generate a realistic government cloud migration RFP dataset with key sections (scope, technical requirements, evaluation criteria). Output the content as structured JSON.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: Structured representation of the RFP text and metadata

units.description: Parse the RFP content to identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). Produce a list of criteria with brief descriptions and source references.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: Table of mandatory compliance criteria with source mapping

units.description: Using the extracted criteria, design a tiered labor pricing model (e.g., Tier A: senior architects, Tier B: mid‑level engineers, Tier C: support staff). Calculate hourly rates, projected effort per criterion, and total cost estimates. Output a structured pricing table.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: Pricing model with tier definitions, rates, effort estimates, and aggregate totals

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a polished executive proposal that incorporates the RFP narrative, compliance mapping, and pricing model. Include a traceability matrix linking each compliance criterion to the corresponding proposal section and price line. Produce the final document in Markdown or Word‑style format.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t3]
units.output_contract: Complete executive proposal document with embedded traceability matrix

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal and pricing model for a government cloud migration RFP, including mandatory technical compliance extraction and a traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The user requests a multi‑step process: ingest the RFP (or synthesize if not provided), extract compliance criteria, build a tiered labor pricing model, and produce an executive proposal with a traceability matrix. This requires data ingestion, natural language extraction, quantitative modeling, and structured report generation, so we split it into four sequential tasks.

tasks.expected_output: Pricing model with tier definitions, rates, effort estimates, and aggregate totals
